boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Documented North Central College rituals, recurring celebrations, and campus symbols.

cards.title: Founders Day on November 11
cards.subtitle: College founding anniversary
cards.notes: Mark November 11 by connecting the date to the College’s first official day of classes in 1861 and its Plainfield College origins.
cards.short_summary: The College recognizes November 11 as its Founders Day.
cards.evidence_claim: North Central College identifies November 11 as Founders Day because Plainfield College opened for its first official day of classes on November 11, 1861.
cards.access_notes: A historical observance; check College announcements for any current programming.

cards.title: Sing “North Central Hail”
cards.subtitle: College alma mater
cards.notes: Listen for the alma mater at formal College occasions and follow the printed lyrics when the program invites everyone to sing.
cards.short_summary: The song’s refrain pledges loyalty to North Central.
cards.evidence_claim: The College’s inauguration program includes a singing of the Alma Mater by all attendees and prints the “North Central Hail” lyrics.
cards.access_notes: Look for the song in official ceremony programs.

cards.title: Learn the NCC Fight Song
cards.subtitle: Cardinal spirit tradition
cards.notes: Join the opening-year pep rally to learn the NCC Fight Song alongside dance team, cheer team, and marching-band performances.
cards.short_summary: Welcome Week explicitly introduces new Cardinals to the fight song.
cards.evidence_claim: North Central’s Welcome Week schedule says its Red & White Night pep rally teaches Cardinal traditions, including the NCC Fight Song.
cards.access_notes: The listed learning opportunity occurs during Welcome Week’s Red & White Night; schedules can change.

cards.title: Start the year in red and white
cards.subtitle: Welcome Week kickoff pep rally
cards.notes: Meet your First-Year Mentor at Old Main Lawn, collect the event T-shirt, then join the new-Cardinal photo and pep rally at Merner.
cards.short_summary: A Welcome Week rally introduces incoming students to Cardinal spirit.
cards.evidence_claim: North Central schedules Red & White Night as a beginning-of-year kickoff pep rally with a new Cardinal photo, performances, and Cardinal traditions.
cards.access_notes: Listed for incoming students during Welcome Week; verify the year’s schedule before attending.

cards.title: Torch Night’s transition marker
cards.subtitle: Cardinal Marching Band tradition
cards.notes: See how the Marching Band frames Torch Night as a celebratory marker between high school and the beginning of the college era.
cards.short_summary: The band handbook calls Torch Night a North Central College tradition.
cards.evidence_claim: North Central’s Cardinal Marching Band handbook describes Torch Night as a College tradition marking the close of high school and beginning of the college era for new students.
cards.source_title: Cardinal Marching Band Syllabus and Handbook
cards.access_notes: This documentation appears in the marching-band handbook; participation details may vary by year.

cards.title: Return for Homecoming
cards.subtitle: Annual alumni and campus gathering
cards.notes: Use the official schedule to pick an all-ages campus event, then pair it with a reunion, concert, or varsity game during the weekend.
cards.short_summary: Homecoming brings alumni and the campus community back together.
cards.evidence_claim: North Central publishes an annual Homecoming schedule with alumni events, reunions, campus programming, and athletic contests.
cards.access_notes: The 2026 schedule lists October 8–11; individual events and registration requirements vary.

cards.entity_name: Battle for the Little Brass Bell
cards.title: Follow the Little Brass Bell game
cards.subtitle: Football rivalry during Homecoming
cards.notes: Catch the designated football rivalry on the official Homecoming schedule and look for the “Battle for the Little Brass Bell” designation.
cards.short_summary: The Little Brass Bell labels a Homecoming football rivalry game.
cards.evidence_claim: North Central’s 2026 Homecoming schedule labels its football game against Wheaton College as the Battle for the Little Brass Bell.
cards.access_notes: The 2026 game is listed for Benedetti-Wehrli Stadium; confirm future opponents and ticket details.

cards.entity_name: Cardinal First Graduation Recognition & Pinning Ceremony
cards.title: Pass the Cardinal First pin
cards.subtitle: First-generation graduation recognition
cards.notes: Eligible first-generation seniors may invite a meaningful faculty or staff mentor to present the Cardinal First pin worn at graduation.
cards.short_summary: A mentor presents each participating graduate’s pin before commencement.
cards.evidence_claim: North Central says the Cardinal First program culminates in a pre-commencement recognition and pinning ceremony where each first-generation graduate chooses a faculty or staff presenter.
cards.access_notes: For participating Cardinal First seniors; contact Cardinal First for current ceremony information.

cards.entity_name: Cardinal First Halfway to Graduation Celebration
cards.title: Celebrate with the “Halfway There” mug
cards.subtitle: Cardinal First sophomore milestone
cards.notes: First-generation sophomores can attend the year-end Halfway to Graduation Celebration, built around half-sized foods and a “Halfway There” half-mug.
cards.short_summary: A deliberately half-themed celebration marks the sophomore milestone.
cards.evidence_claim: North Central describes Cardinal First’s year-end Halfway to Graduation Celebration as featuring half-sandwiches, half-cookies, Arnold Palmers, and a “Halfway There” half-mug.
cards.access_notes: For Cardinal First sophomores; contact the program for current eligibility and event timing.

cards.title: Spot the presidential medallion
cards.subtitle: Academic-regalia ceremony symbol
cards.notes: At a ceremonial event with academic regalia, look for the bronze medallion bearing the College seal and past presidents’ names and service dates.
cards.short_summary: The president wears this seal-bearing medallion in academic-regalia ceremonies.
cards.evidence_claim: North Central’s inauguration program states that the presidential medallion, featuring the College seal, is worn by the president in ceremonies that include academic regalia.
cards.access_notes: Visible only at applicable formal College ceremonies.
